claims.text: The local catalog models the Tropical Mega Battle regional first place prize as a one-row unnumbered promotional source group containing No.1 Trainer at source index 110.

Bulbapedia says the No.1 Trainer card was awarded to champions of each regional Challenge Road '99 SUMMER event held between July and August 1999, with elementary school participants eligible for Tropical Mega Battle and older students eligible for Secret Super Battle.

Pokumon describes the Challenge Road '99 SUMMER structure as having junior Tropical Mega Battle and senior Secret Super Battle divisions, qualifying rounds, final tournaments, and Best in Japan deciding matches.
Bulbapedia attributes the Tropical Mega Battle print to artwork featuring Exeggutor and the event logo by Ken Sugimori and Hiromi Ito.

Bulbapedia presents the 1999 Tropical Mega Battle print as a Challenge Road '99 SUMMER regional prize and distinguishes later 2000 Best in Japan / World Challenge Summer prints with personalization and different tournament routing.

No.1 Trainer matters here because the card is not just a collectible trophy; it is a physical credential of regional victory inside the system that sent junior players toward the Tropical Mega Battle stage.

Agents should preserve Challenge Road '99 SUMMER, Tropical Mega Battle junior division, regional first-place route, source index 110, No.1 Trainer rank, Exeggutor/event-logo art, and non-equivalence with Secret Super Battle, 2000 World Challenge, Best in Japan, Neo Road, Battle Road, and Worlds No.1 Trainer memories before accepting a match.

narrative.human_title: No.1 Trainer: the regional win made portable
narrative.why_it_matters: This is where the card game starts looking like organized sport and childhood myth at the same time. No.1 Trainer is not powerful because of attack text; it is powerful because it records a child becoming first at a regional gate on the road to Tropical Mega Battle. The Exeggutor and event-logo artwork makes the card feel tropical, but the true object is the apparatus: Challenge Road, junior division, regional conference, first place, and a path pointed toward Hawaii. An agent has to preserve the exact route or the phrase No.1 Trainer becomes a fog bank.
